snippet.title: Darkenstein 3D - Announcement Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Darkenstein 3D Director's Cut is out this October 23rd on PS5 and Xbox!

A homeless man, a dog called Gunther and the Nazis that stole him. 
And now, you must venture out on a quest to get your beloved dog back from the enemies.

https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020880
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/darkenstein-3d-directors-cut/9n0xq9ztdst5

Developed by Rowye.
